verdicts.title: Modular forms on indefinite orthogonal groups of rank three
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We develop a theory of modular forms on the groups $\mathrm{SO}(3,n+1)$, $n \geq 3$. This is very similar to, but simpler, than the notion of modular forms on quaternionic exceptional groups, which was initiated by Gross-Wallach and Gan-Gross-Savin.
